gloss: confidential (within a company); for internal use only

definitions.gloss: confidential (within a company); for internal use only
definitions.explanation: A classification label indicating that a document or piece of information is restricted to employees of the company and must not be shared externally. Commonly stamped or printed on sensitive business documents.

examples.japanese: この{資料|しりょう}は{社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}です。
{社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}の{情報|じょうほう}を{外部|がいぶ}に{漏|も}らさないでください。
examples.english: Please do not leak confidential information to outsiders.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}で{配|くば}られた{社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}の{書類|しょるい}は、{使用後|しようご}にシュレッダーで{処分|しょぶん}することになっている。
examples.english: Confidential documents distributed at the meeting are to be shredded after use.

notes:
A compound of {社内|しゃない} (within the company) and {秘|ひ} (secret, confidential). This label is a standard part of Japanese corporate document classification. It is often stamped in red on the cover or header of documents.

DOCUMENT CLASSIFICATION LEVELS (from least to most restricted):
- {社内|しゃない}{限|かぎ}り: for internal distribution (less restrictive)
- {社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}: confidential within the company
- {部外|ぶがい}{秘|ひ}: confidential outside the department
- {極秘|ごくひ}: top secret

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}の{資料|しりょう}: confidential materials
- {社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}の{情報|じょうほう}: confidential information
- {社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}{扱|あつか}い: treated as confidential

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {機密|きみつ}: classified, secret — a stronger, more formal term
- {極秘|ごくひ}: top secret — the highest level of confidentiality
- {部外|ぶがい}{秘|ひ}: not to be disclosed outside the department
